title: Step 1: Add Friend System (send/accept/decline requests, friends list)

requirements.text: Add a Friend data model to the backend with friend request states (Pending, Accepted, Declined). Store friend relationships as a list of FriendRequest records with sender, receiver, status, and timestamp fields.
acceptanceCriteria: FriendRequest type exists with fields: sender (Principal), receiver (Principal), status (Pending | Accepted | Declined), createdAt (Int)
Stable storage for friend requests is initialized in the actor

requirements.text: Add backend functions: sendFriendRequest(receiver: Principal), respondToFriendRequest(sender: Principal, accept: Bool), cancelFriendRequest(receiver: Principal), unfriend(friendPrincipal: Principal), getIncomingFriendRequests(), getOutgoingFriendRequests(), getFriendsList(), and getFriendshipStatus(otherPrincipal: Principal).
acceptanceCriteria: sendFriendRequest creates a Pending request if none exists and caller != receiver
respondToFriendRequest updates status to Accepted or Declined
unfriend removes both directions of the friendship
getFriendsList returns only Accepted connections for the caller
getFriendshipStatus returns the current status (or null) between caller and target

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks in useQueries.ts for all new friend system backend functions: useSendFriendRequest, useRespondToFriendRequest, useCancelFriendRequest, useUnfriend, useGetIncomingFriendRequests, useGetOutgoingFriendRequests, useGetFriendsList, useGetFriendshipStatus.
acceptanceCriteria: Each mutation hook calls its corresponding backend method via useActor
Query hooks use appropriate staleTime and invalidate related queries on mutation success

requirements.text: Update the UserProfilePage to show a dynamic friend request button based on friendship status. If not friends: show 'Add Friend' button. If request pending (outgoing): show 'Request Sent' (cancel option). If request pending (incoming): show 'Accept' and 'Decline' buttons. If already friends: show 'Friends' with an 'Unfriend' option in a dropdown.

quotes: Send/receive friend requests from profile pages

acceptanceCriteria: Friend button states correctly reflect getFriendshipStatus result
Actions trigger the corresponding mutation hooks
UI updates optimistically or refetches after each action

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo as a single actor
Do NOT build Friend Zone Page, messaging, or sharing in this step — only the core friend request system
nonGoals: Friend Zone Page (dedicated section) — saved for next step
Direct messaging — saved for a later step
Sharing features — saved for a later step
